junro.title: Prioritree UX — the web-app tier worked through prior to the MCP surface: the human comparator's vote surface over the core's five-op interface — FastAPI-served, the entire front end projected from Python (Shoelace chrome, HTMX wire, Jinja2 render, Web Components under separation of concerns), CQRS-shaped backend communication, lifecycle make targets — the full junro, all seats participating
inputs: the collaborator's rulings of 2026-11-22 (the UX ask prior to the MCP surface; the stack re-anchor: Shoelace + HTMX + separation-of-concerns Web Components, all frontend things generated from Python — the front end a projection from Python things; the CQRS agenda; the existing FastAPI server; lifecycle make targets; the full-junro all-seats mandate)

Q-frontend-stack's ruling at the prioritree-birth store (2026-11-19): HTMX carries UX-to-backend, Shoelace via CDN, Web Components under separation of concerns, Jinja2 always, generated from structure, hand-authored frontend out of grammar

Q-setup-arch's ruled four-form architecture (prioritree-birth): library-first, the CLI wraps, FastAPI serves, the web fronts — the web-app tier is the human comparator's vote surface, opening on the core library's public-face gate (green: prioritree-core done)
the core's five-op interface (Q-solution-space, prioritree-core): register_run, next_pair, cast_vote, read_vote_state, tally_rank — the surface this effort fronts
Q-mcp-surface's banked ruling (prioritree-core): the MCP surface composes when the service era arrives — this effort is prior to it

structure.purpose: THE PER-UNIT PIPELINE (the core store's precedent): THE CENSUS FIRST — ungated tansa/shindan/rikai packets over the existing ground (the FastAPI server, the tech notes, the current web state; shindan naming the API's current error shape — R5's census clause); then THE DESIGN LANE — ungated suisen/keisan/hyoka/moho packets; then togo's gated synthesis closing G-UX-DESIGN-BRIEF; each build unit's ungated discovery legs + gated brief precede its build; THE ROUTE GROWS UNIT-BY-UNIT (each build unit's pair auto-stamps at its build-add; its rich build gate mints before — the composition model).
structure.entry_condition: G-COMPOSITION is green (the composition validated at the route's head); the census fires first, its findings assumed by none of this composition.

structure.purpose: THE WEB TIER'S BUILD — the ruled unit set, one module per dispatch (the sizing law): service (the existing FastAPI server grown into the CQRS lanes over the core's five ops — R2; every touched API surface brought into ThreePart compliance as-we-go — R5, no separate remediation unit), web (the entire front end projected from Python — Shoelace via CDN, Web Components under separation of concerns, HTMX, Jinja2 always, generated from structure; hand-authored artifacts out of grammar — R1; the web fronts the service — Q-setup-arch's layering), lifecycle (the Makefile's service-management targets, start/stop/etc. — R3: "room for service targets later" is now); each lands per its approved brief (the exact-task law), kensho's independent verification per build gate, one-commit-per-increment.
structure.entry_condition: G-UX-DESIGN-BRIEF is green — the design is the spec; each unit's own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF green before its dispatch (the precedence law).

structure.purpose: THE EFFORT'S BOOKEND (the birth store's close form): hansei's retro (R4's debrief seat — the friction ledger the intake), the effort's records (the MCP-surface era named next, Q-mcp-surface banked — this effort prior to it), the done call at the collaborator's ruling.
structure.entry_condition: the route's build gates closed green and the collaborator has called the close.

conditions: the composition lands at the store's evidence home (.junro/evidence/Q-ux-surface/route-composition*.md — the set: the stages spine, gates-a, gates-b, increments) — the opening whole: stages, gates, increments, the census placed FIRST with none of its findings assumed, every seat placed (R4: no seat bypassed)

every choice cites its ruling: R1–R5 + the birth store's precedents (Q-frontend-stack's projection law, Q-solution-space's five-op interface, Q-setup-arch's web-app tier) + the core store's pipeline precedent

the collaborator validates the composition — the gate is the validation (the birth store's composition-validation entry condition, carried as the route's head gate); the outcome records against compose/route; no route dispatch fires before it is green

THE DESIGN BRIEF LANDED: togo's synthesis over the census (census/ground, census/error-shape, census/mechanism) + the design lane (design/flows, design/cqrs-mapping, design/presentation, design/adversarial, design/blind-walk); a divergence that survives reconciliation blocks the brief, never rides it silently (the pipeline-parallelism safeguard)

the brief carries the design-work whole R1/R2 leave open — never settled in the composition: the UX flows (the comparator's journey over the five ops), the CQRS op-mapping (the ops' command/query lanes at the service surface + the HTMX wire's lanes — cited back to R2), the tally presentation (the ranked whole rendered from tally_rank's frozen result — tie groups, coverage data, the safe halt shown honestly), the projection architecture (the front end's source structure + its Python generator — R1)

the brief carries the ThreePart remediation map (R5): the census's error-shape diagnosis folded forward — every build unit's brief names the API surfaces it touches + their expected/found/next-action compliance plan
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the design judged ready-to-build; the build units' briefs cite it; their dispatches fire only after their own brief gates green
hansei's retro landed: the debrief over the effort whole, the friction ledger the intake, the lessons named
the effort's records landed: the CONTINUATION entry (the landing state named honestly); the MCP-surface era named next (banked, not composed)
the collaborator rules the close — the done call recorded same-turn; the route's status set done at the ruling (the birth store's G-BIRTH-RECORDS form)

the build brief for service landed + approved — togo's synthesis over discover/service + understand/service + the approved design + the census; the brief carrying the CQRS lanes per the op-mapping, the touched surfaces' ThreePart plan (R5), the scope fence, the return forms; the collaborator approves — the dispatches fire only after

the brief carries the sixth query's exact spec (GET /runs/{run_id}/manifest via Serialize.manifest + Persist.manifest, zero core edits — the reconciliation's answer to the manifest gap, divergence ledger #1)

the brief carries the ThreePart cure map (×3 the 400 re-badge family → the schema-violation ThreePart form; ×2 the framework-default 404/405 → the app-level StarletteHTTPException handler — 21/21 after, per the approved design)
the service surface lands per its approved brief — the exact-task law

the CQRS segregation green: commands (the state-changing acts) segregated from queries (the state reads) at the service surface over the five ops (R2); the core's ruled refusals + the DONE signal carried at the API by type, in the family grammar

the ThreePart compliance green on every touched surface (R5, as-we-go): every 4xx/5xx body carries expected/found/next-action — never a bare status, never a stack leak, never a silent OK where a refusal belongs; the census's error-shape map cured on the touched surfaces
pyright 0 errors 0 warnings + ruff zero findings, zero ignores; kensho's independent re-run green (validate/service)

THE BUILD BRIEF for the unit probe LANDED and APPROVED: togo's synthesis over the unit's discovery census (discover/probe) + mechanism analysis (understand/probe) — the brief carrying the banked shapes, the scope fence, and the return forms — the dispatches cite this brief
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the brief judged ready-to-build; the unit's dispatches fire only after

the exact-task spec landed — togo's bytes whole over the approved unit brief: every edit fenced-bytes-exact, every insertion point named, every expected outcome byte-named (FR-MEM-0011's doctrine: the execution seat receives nothing to figure out)

the spec carries the generator's emission whole — the source structure to the artifacts, the regen/check discipline, the exact new-file contents (R1's projection law at the bytes level: zero hand-authored frontend artifacts)
the collaborator approves the spec — the build dispatch fires only after
the web surface lands per its approved brief — the exact-task law

the projection law green (R1): the ENTIRE front end generated from Python — Jinja2 always, Shoelace via CDN, Web Components under separation of concerns, the HTMX wire; zero hand-authored frontend artifacts on disk (out of grammar; the generated surface regenerates from its source structure, never hand-edited)

the comparator's flow green end-to-end through the CQRS lanes: register a run → the pair → the vote → the progress → the ranked whole; the tally presentation renders tally_rank's frozen result honestly (tie groups, coverage data, the safe halt shown, never a partial ranking dressed as whole)
the ThreePart mandate green on touched surfaces (R5); pyright 0/0 + ruff zero findings; kensho's independent re-run green (validate/web)

THE BUILD BRIEF for the unit web LANDED and APPROVED: togo's synthesis over the unit's discovery census (discover/web) + mechanism analysis (understand/web) — the brief carrying the banked shapes, the scope fence, and the return forms — the dispatches cite this brief
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the brief judged ready-to-build; the unit's dispatches fire only after

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-ux-surface", "ruling": "THE ERROR SHAPE, MANDATORY (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: \"the api absolutely does not follow the errors teach methodology. So, we are going to have to fix that as we go. The ThreePart is mandatory in this codebase now.\"): the existing FastAPI API does not follow the errors-teach methodology — and the fix rides this effort as-we-go (no separate remediation effort; each unit that touches an API surface brings that surface into compliance as it lands). THE THREEPART IS MANDATORY IN THIS CODEBASE NOW: every error response carries expected / found / next-action — the shape this codebase's own instruments already teach (the junro engine's every refusal: \"REFUSED — Expected: ... Found: ... Next-action: ...\"; the core's ruled refusals — Q-granularity R2's \"expected/found/next-action naming the legal set\", R12's SAFE HALT \"carrying expected/found/next-action naming the isolated items/components and the exact closing pairs\"). At the API: every 4xx/5xx response body is a ThreePart error — expected (the legal state named), found (what the request actually carried / what occurred), next-action (the named cure or legal form — self-correcting) — never a bare status code, never a stack leak, never a silent OK where a refusal belongs. Every build unit of this route inherits this: the units touching the API bring the touched surfaces into ThreePart compliance as-we-go."}

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-ux-surface", "ruling": "THE REPORT AUTHORSHIP LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: \"the seats write their reports via the report op... translating from returns is not how we do things anymore... each seat is supposed to write its own report.\"): every dispatched seat writes its own completion report via the junro packet report op — actor = the seat, packet = its packet, content = the seat's own report in its own words; the report rides the ledger from the seat's own actor stamp. shinko NEVER translates a seat's return into a report — the convenor's ledger duties are the machinery events alone (dispatch, result, gate) and the evidence landing (the result's output artifact); the report is the member's act, the member's voice. THE STANDING DISPATCH FORM: every dispatch prompt carries the report step — \"file your completion report via the junro packet report op (actor=<seat>, packet=<id>, store=<path>) before returning\" — a dispatch without the report step is out of grammar. THE TRANSITION (this effort): the three census packets' shinko-recorded reports (census/ground, census/error-shape, census/mechanism) were filed pre-correction in the translation form — they stand as the machinery's pre-correction records, SUPERSEDED by the seats' own reports when the seats file them (append-only; the seat-authored reports are the packet's authoritative voice); the design packets' reports (design/flows, design/cqrs-mapping, design/presentation) are filed by their seats from the start — no translated report ever lands for them."}

amendments.what: The service unit's build-add collision, cured by the engine's different-id path: the manually pre-composed synthesize/service (mimicking the core store's static shape, against the composition model's own 'no manual pre-composition' note) claimed the 'service' suffix, blocking build/service (the build-add's auto-stamp demands the pipeline free). The build rides as build/probe · jikko · G-SERVICE (the core store's registry-collision precedent); the stamp minted G-PROBE-BRIEF + synthesize/probe — the probe lane carrying the EXACT-TASK SPEC (FR-MEM-0011's doctrine: the bytes authored at synthesis, nothing to figure out at the execution seat). The two-lane form: synthesize/service · G-SERVICE-BRIEF = the UNIT BRIEF (the scope fence, the CQRS lanes, the ThreePart cure map, the return forms — the minted conditions); synthesize/probe · G-PROBE-BRIEF = the EXACT-TASK SPEC (the bytes-level build plan). The flow: discovery legs → unit brief green → exact-task spec green → build (G-SERVICE, kensho independent). The web and lifecycle units ride their build-adds directly (no manual pre-composition — the lesson held).
amendments.why: The append-only route cannot remove the manual pair; the engine's next-action offered the different-id path; the probe form is the core store's own collision precedent and maps the extra lane onto real work (the exact-task brief discipline) — every structure carries work, none orphaned.

amendments.what: The two-lane build-unit form adopted as the STANDING SHAPE (the service unit's collision cure, now deliberate): each build unit rides (1) the UNIT-BRIEF lane — synthesize/<unit> · G-<UNIT>-BRIEF, minted by the build-add's own auto-stamp (never manually pre-composed — FR-MEM-0020's law held: build/web's add stamped G-WEB-BRIEF + synthesize/web clean), closing at the collaborator's approval; (2) the EXACT-TASK-SPEC lane — synthesize/<unit>spec · G-<UNITSPEC>-BRIEF, manually composed with a UNIQUE SUFFIX (the collision guard is suffix-based: 'webspec' cannot collide with the stamp's 'web'), carrying FR-MEM-0011's bytes-at-synthesis doctrine, closing at its own collaborator approval; (3) the BUILD — build/<unit> · G-<UNIT>, jikko executing the spec, kensho independent (validate/<unit>). The web unit composes first under this form: G-WEBSPEC-BRIEF + synthesize/webspec minted manual (3 conditions), G-WEB minted with the composition's four conditions, build/web's stamp minting G-WEB-BRIEF + synthesize/web.
amendments.why: The service unit's accidental two-lane form (the collision's cure) mapped onto real work — the brief's approval point before the bytes are authored; adopting it deliberately for every build unit keeps the rhythm (brief → spec → build) without the collision that forced it the first time; the unique-suffix manual lane is the engine-legal composition (the guard is suffix-based, verified at the service unit's own recovery).

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-ux-surface", "ruling": "THE SIZING GATE AT THE CONVENOR (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: \"the web build dispatch to jikko was so so so a fat dispatch.\"): the build/web dispatch carried the WHOLE 13-step unit-build in one sitting — five whole files, three regional edits, the 16-artifact emission, the five-target floor, the report — a FAT DISPATCH, FR-MEM-0010/0011's class striking the live channel; the session's return truncated at the transit seam mid-verification, the report event never landed, the tree state unknown from the convenor's seat. THE DOCTRINE SHARPENED (amendment 14's extension at this route): the execution dispatch decomposes PER STEP-GROUP — a unit's build lands in small mechanical dispatches (the generator pair + the emission; the web module + the mount; the tests + the re-target; the floor + the report), each its own dispatch on the packet with exact asks and bounded returns; ONE dispatch = ONE step-group, NEVER the unit's whole. THE CONVENOR HOLDS THE SIZING LAW, NOT THE GATE: the engine's sizing gate keys on the prompt's problem-count (n_problems ≤ 2) — it cannot see step-count or work-load; the ask-ceiling applies to the convenor's dispatches as the seats' returns — a dispatch whose work would fill a session's budget is out of grammar however exact its bytes. THE TRANSIT SEAM COMPOUNDS: fat dispatch → long session → the return truncates (~4-5KB, FR-MEM-0018's seam family) — the two seams compound; the cure is sizing at dispatch time. THE RECOVERY FORM: position report FIRST (small, read-only — the tree's state per the spec's steps), then the remainder per step-group."}

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-ux-surface", "ruling": "THE 13-DISPATCH LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: \"it was probably impossible to complete due to the amount of task and ambiguity of those tasks.\" / \"it should be 13 dispatches\"): the fat build's failure diagnosed — the AMOUNT of task (thirteen interdependent steps in one session) plus the AMBIGUITY of those tasks (the sequencing, the verification points, the floor's timing all held at the execution seat's interpretation) made completion impossible; the sizing law sharpens to PER-STEP: the spec's command sequence maps 1:1 onto dispatches — ONE STEP, ONE DISPATCH, ONE BOUNDED RETURN. Each step-dispatch carries exactly its step's fenced bytes + its read-back + its expected outcome — nothing to sequence, nothing to hold, nothing to interpret: the ambiguity dies with the bundle. THE RECOVERY FORM AT BUILD/WEB: dispatch 1 = the position report (read-only, ≤20 lines: the 13 steps' done/not-done states against DISK — the tree is the truth, not the session's memory; a fresh session, not the fat one's resume); then one dispatch per remaining step in the spec's order; the commit (the sequence's 13th) rides the coordinator's hand as ruled. THE STANDING FORM: every build increment at every route henceforth decomposes per-step at dispatch time — the spec's command sequence IS the dispatch plan."}

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-ux-surface", "ruling": "THE TEMPLATE-SOURCE LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: \"Generating all the things from python is not putting the content in python...but having separate jinja template files that are loaded to generate the surface. Not putting all the jinja content directly inside functions as giant concatenations... We need to rethink this part.\"): R1's projection law CLARIFIED at the architecture level — \"the entire front end a projection from Python\" means Python LOADS separate Jinja template files and generates/renders the surface from them (template + data → the served page); it does NOT mean the template content lives inside Python modules as giant string constants or concatenations. THE WEBSPEC v1'S web_structure.py FORM IS SUPERSEDED (the 14 template bodies + the CSS + the Web Components JS as Python data — out of grammar); the corrected architecture: separate template FILES as the authored source (tracked, the source of truth — the scaffold's YAML precedent, not its emission), Python the loader/renderer (Jinja2's filesystem loader at request time — the projection), the giant-concatenation form dead. THE RETHINK SETTLES: the template source home; the authored-vs-generated line (what remains emitted — if anything); the --check/regen-stamp discipline's fate (the never-hand-edit law's scope — the SOURCE is authored by definition, the emission is what regenerates); the Web Components surface's home; the CDN pins' home; web_scaffold.py's fate (landed at 202 lines from the superseded spec — reworked or replaced). No build step fires on the superseded architecture; the re-spec re-presents at G-WEBSPEC-BRIEF."}

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-ux-surface", "ruling": "THE TEMPLATE-SOURCE LAW, THE MAIN POINT (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, stated twice for emphasis — the birth store's Q-frontend-stack convention): verbatim — \"the main point of templates is template file, load them, generate the output from them.\" The template pattern's essence, three beats: template FILES (authored, on disk, the source of truth), LOADED (by the Python tier — the loader, not a container), the OUTPUT GENERATED from them (template + data → the served surface). R9 named the architecture; this ruling names its point: content-in-Python and giant concatenations do not merely miss the style — they abandon the pattern itself (a template that is not a file cannot be loaded; a load that has no file is not a projection). The standing content-in-configuration law reconciles clean: the template files ARE the content's home (data, in Jinja's own sense); web.py renders (code); nothing is imprisoned."}

amendments.what: THE WEBSPEC SUPERSEDED (Q-ux-surface R9/R10, the collaborator's template-source law): synthesize/webspec's architecture — web_structure.py (the 14 template bodies + the CSS + the Web Components JS as Python string constants) + web_scaffold.py (the artifact emitter) — is out of grammar; the corrected architecture: separate Jinja template files as the AUTHORED source (tracked, the source of truth), the Python tier the loader/renderer (template + data → the served surface), no content-in-Python, no giant concatenations. THE BUILD PAUSED at step 2 of 13: web_scaffold.py LANDED (202 lines, from the superseded bytes — fate pending the rethink: removal or rework); web_structure.py never landed (step 1 cancelled); no emission, no floor, no report event. THE RETHINK (togo, dispatched): the architecture re-settled per R9/R10 — the template source home, the loader/render seam, the static assets' home + serving, the CDN pins' home, the Web Components' home, the --check/regen discipline's fate, the generator's fate (the landed 202-line file ruled) — the amended brief clauses + the re-spec whole re-presenting at G-WEB-BRIEF + G-WEBSPEC-BRIEF; hyoka's adversarial pass rides before the presentation (the spec-defect history earns it); the build re-plans per R8 (one step, one dispatch).

open_questions.question: What is the UX for Priori-tree's human comparator — the web-app tier's vote surface over the core's five-op interface (register_run, next_pair, cast_vote, read_vote_state, tally_rank), FastAPI-served, the entire front end projected from Python (Shoelace chrome, HTMX wire, Jinja2 render, Web Components under separation of concerns), CQRS-shaped backend communication, lifecycle make targets — worked through prior to the MCP surface?

rulings.text: THE UX STACK, RE-ANCHORED (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, restating Q-frontend-stack at the prioritree-birth store for this effort): Shoelace for the CSS and web components (via CDN); separation-of-concerns architecture (Web Components); HTMX for backend communication; Jinja2 templating always; generated from structure — and the entire front end is a projection from Python things: ALL frontend things are generated from Python, including the entire Web Components surface. Hand-authored frontend artifacts are out of grammar; the web surface regenerates from its source structure (the content-in-configuration law at the web tier; the never-hand-edit-cycle-generated-files law inherited there).

THE CQRS AGENDA (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim: "We run a CQRS agenda. Command Query Response Segregation."): the web tier's backend communication segregates commands (the state-changing acts) from queries (the state reads) at the service surface, served by the existing FastAPI server over the core's five-op interface. The concrete op-mapping and the HTMX wire's command/query lanes compose in this effort's design work, cited back to this ruling.

THE SERVICE GROUND AND LIFECYCLE TARGETS (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22): an existing FastAPI server is in place — the setup skeleton's ruled API tier (Q-setup-arch at prioritree-birth: "the FastAPI service serves it") — and the effort grows the Makefile's lifecycle management targets (start, stop, etc.): "room for service targets later" (the birth ruling's own clause) is now.

THE GOVERNANCE FORM (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22): this effort is managed via a full junro — all team member participation: every seat rides the route — keikaku composes; tansa, shindan, and rikai discover and diagnose; suisen and keisan recommend and calculate; hyoka assesses adversarially; moho blind-walks; togo synthesizes and integrates; jikko executes; kensho verifies; hansei debriefs; shinko dispatches. No seat is bypassed; the route's composition realizes this mandate.

THE ERROR SHAPE, MANDATORY (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: "the api absolutely does not follow the errors teach methodology. So, we are going to have to fix that as we go. The ThreePart is mandatory in this codebase now."): the existing FastAPI API does not follow the errors-teach methodology — and the fix rides this effort as-we-go (no separate remediation effort; each unit that touches an API surface brings that surface into compliance as it lands). THE THREEPART IS MANDATORY IN THIS CODEBASE NOW: every error response carries expected / found / next-action — the shape this codebase's own instruments already teach (the junro engine's every refusal: "REFUSED — Expected: ... Found: ... Next-action: ..."; the core's ruled refusals — Q-granularity R2's "expected/found/next-action naming the legal set", R12's SAFE HALT "carrying expected/found/next-action naming the isolated items/components and the exact closing pairs"). At the API: every 4xx/5xx response body is a ThreePart error — expected (the legal state named), found (what the request actually carried / what occurred), next-action (the named cure or legal form — self-correcting) — never a bare status code, never a stack leak, never a silent OK where a refusal belongs. Every build unit of this route inherits this: the units touching the API bring the touched surfaces into ThreePart compliance as-we-go.

THE REPORT AUTHORSHIP LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: "the seats write their reports via the report op... translating from returns is not how we do things anymore... each seat is supposed to write its own report."): every dispatched seat writes its own completion report via the junro packet report op — actor = the seat, packet = its packet, content = the seat's own report in its own words; the report rides the ledger from the seat's own actor stamp. shinko NEVER translates a seat's return into a report — the convenor's ledger duties are the machinery events alone (dispatch, result, gate) and the evidence landing (the result's output artifact); the report is the member's act, the member's voice. THE STANDING DISPATCH FORM: every dispatch prompt carries the report step — "file your completion report via the junro packet report op (actor=<seat>, packet=<id>, store=<path>) before returning" — a dispatch without the report step is out of grammar. THE TRANSITION (this effort): the three census packets' shinko-recorded reports (census/ground, census/error-shape, census/mechanism) were filed pre-correction in the translation form — they stand as the machinery's pre-correction records, SUPERSEDED by the seats' own reports when the seats file them (append-only; the seat-authored reports are the packet's authoritative voice); the design packets' reports (design/flows, design/cqrs-mapping, design/presentation) are filed by their seats from the start — no translated report ever lands for them.

THE SIZING GATE AT THE CONVENOR (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: "the web build dispatch to jikko was so so so a fat dispatch."): the build/web dispatch carried the WHOLE 13-step unit-build in one sitting — five whole files, three regional edits, the 16-artifact emission, the five-target floor, the report — a FAT DISPATCH, FR-MEM-0010/0011's class striking the live channel; the session's return truncated at the transit seam mid-verification, the report event never landed, the tree state unknown from the convenor's seat. THE DOCTRINE SHARPENED (amendment 14's extension at this route): the execution dispatch decomposes PER STEP-GROUP — a unit's build lands in small mechanical dispatches (the generator pair + the emission; the web module + the mount; the tests + the re-target; the floor + the report), each its own dispatch on the packet with exact asks and bounded returns; ONE dispatch = ONE step-group, NEVER the unit's whole. THE CONVENOR HOLDS THE SIZING LAW, NOT THE GATE: the engine's sizing gate keys on the prompt's problem-count (n_problems ≤ 2) — it cannot see step-count or work-load; the ask-ceiling applies to the convenor's dispatches as the seats' returns — a dispatch whose work would fill a session's budget is out of grammar however exact its bytes. THE TRANSIT SEAM COMPOUNDS: fat dispatch → long session → the return truncates (~4-5KB, FR-MEM-0018's seam family) — the two seams compound; the cure is sizing at dispatch time. THE RECOVERY FORM: position report FIRST (small, read-only — the tree's state per the spec's steps), then the remainder per step-group.

THE 13-DISPATCH LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: "it was probably impossible to complete due to the amount of task and ambiguity of those tasks." / "it should be 13 dispatches"): the fat build's failure diagnosed — the AMOUNT of task (thirteen interdependent steps in one session) plus the AMBIGUITY of those tasks (the sequencing, the verification points, the floor's timing all held at the execution seat's interpretation) made completion impossible; the sizing law sharpens to PER-STEP: the spec's command sequence maps 1:1 onto dispatches — ONE STEP, ONE DISPATCH, ONE BOUNDED RETURN. Never step-groups (R7's four-group form is still fat — superseded); never the unit's whole. Each step-dispatch carries exactly its step's fenced bytes + its read-back + its expected outcome — nothing to sequence, nothing to hold, nothing to interpret: the ambiguity dies with the bundle. THE RECOVERY FORM AT BUILD/WEB: dispatch 1 = the position report (read-only, ≤20 lines: the 13 steps' done/not-done states against DISK — the tree is the truth, not the session's memory; a fresh session, not the fat one's resume); then one dispatch per remaining step in the spec's order; the commit (the sequence's 13th) rides the coordinator's hand as ruled. THE STANDING FORM: every build increment at every route henceforth decomposes per-step at dispatch time — the spec's command sequence IS the dispatch plan.

THE TEMPLATE-SOURCE LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: "Generating all the things from python is not putting the content in python...but having separate jinja template files that are loaded to generate the surface. Not putting all the jinja content directly inside functions as giant concatenations... We need to rethink this part."): R1's projection law CLARIFIED at the architecture level — "the entire front end a projection from Python" means Python LOADS separate Jinja template files and generates/renders the surface from them (template + data → the served page); it does NOT mean the template content lives inside Python modules as giant string constants or concatenations. THE WEBSPEC v1'S web_structure.py FORM IS SUPERSEDED (the 14 template bodies + the CSS + the Web Components JS as Python data — out of grammar); the corrected architecture: separate template FILES as the authored source (tracked, the source of truth — the scaffold's YAML precedent, not its emission), Python the loader/renderer (Jinja2's filesystem loader at request time — the projection), the giant-concatenation form dead. THE RETHINK SETTLES: the template source home; the authored-vs-generated line (what remains emitted — if anything); the --check/regen-stamp discipline's fate (the never-hand-edit law's scope — the SOURCE is authored by definition, the emission is what regenerates); the Web Components surface's home; the CDN pins' home; web_scaffold.py's fate (landed at 202 lines from the superseded spec — reworked or replaced). No build step fires on the superseded architecture; the re-spec re-presents at G-WEBSPEC-BRIEF.

THE TEMPLATE-SOURCE LAW, THE MAIN POINT (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, stated twice for emphasis — the birth store's Q-frontend-stack convention): verbatim — "the main point of templates is template file, load them, generate the output from them." The template pattern's essence, three beats: template FILES (authored, on disk, the source of truth), LOADED (by the Python tier — the loader, not a container), the OUTPUT GENERATED from them (template + data → the served surface). R9 named the architecture; this ruling names its point: content-in-Python and giant concatenations do not merely miss the style — they abandon the pattern itself (a template that is not a file cannot be loaded; a load that has no file is not a projection). The standing content-in-configuration law reconciles clean: the template files ARE the content's home (data, in Jinja's own sense); web.py renders (code); nothing is imprisoned.
